title: Affiliate Content Posts Log
description: Log of every affiliate content post made by the affiliate-content-creator skill

post_id.description: UUID v4 uniquely identifying this post

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the post was created/logged

product_name.description: Name of the affiliate product posted

platform.description: Platform(s) the content was posted to

post_url.description: URL of the published post (null if manual-post-required)

hook_variant_used.description: Label of the A/B hook variant selected for the post (e.g. 'Variant C (Aspiration/Transformation)')

caption.description: Full caption text used in the post

hashtags.description: Hashtags used in the post (first should be #ad)

affiliate_url.description: Affiliate link URL included in the post or bio

scheduled_time.description: ISO 8601 scheduled publish time (null if posted immediately)

niche.description: Niche keyword the user provided (or agent selected)

quality_gate_version.description: Version of the quality gate checks applied before posting
